# RMX5061_16.0.10.500(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: OTA descriptionInfo
> OTA 指纹: `RMX5061_11.F.46_2460_202609102102`

## Security
- Integrates the Sept. 2026 Android security patch to enhance system security.

## Every detail covered
- You can now preview and adjust the incoming call screen when editing contact information, enjoying a more intuitive, personalised display.
- The Weather app's homepage now displays moonrise, moonset and lunar phase details, helping you stay up-to-date with the moon's phases and schedule.
- Adds AI Recording Sticker, allowing text and image markers to be added while recording or reviewing audio to capture key moments.

## Security & privacy
- You can now turn off "Accessibility" permissions with just one tap. If apps from outside official stores attempt risky actions, you'll get a notification so you can instantly revoke the relevant permission.

## And More
- Improves the Categories view in the app drawer by adding an "App suggestions" category that intelligently recommends your most-used apps for quicker access.
- Improves transition animations for launching and switching apps in "Recent Tasks", delivering smoother, more responsive operation throughout multitasking.
檢視更多內容和參與討論。

## 注意事項
1.本次升級不會刪除或修改任何使用者資料，但仍建議您在更新前做好資料備份。

2.升級後安裝套件會自動刪除，不會佔用裝置儲存空間。

3.升級後，為提升使用體驗，系統將在背景進行深度最佳化。最佳化期間，裝置可能會出現輕微發熱、卡頓、耗電增加，屬於正常情況，您無需擔心，1-2天裝置會自行恢復。

4.本文中所示的產品介面內容(包括但不限於UI、背景)僅作功能展示，不同裝置、版本、區域有所差異，請以實際版本功能及介面為準。

5.新版本使用過程中，若您遇到任何問題，可聯絡官方客服進行回饋和諮詢。
